newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates ended higher on Sunday amid shortage of funds and are likely to open steady on Monday as no major inflows are expected, dealers said.
The overnight funding rates moved in a band of 16.90 and 17 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Dealers said the market was short of funds at close and borrowers were forced to approach the discount window of the State (central) Bank of Pakistan.
